title: "mint (Compound Whitepaper)"
---
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    [*] --> q_validate: msg.sender calls mint(amountUnderlying)
    q_validate --> q_accrue: amountUnderlying > 0
    q_validate --> q_error: amountUnderlying = 0
    q_accrue --> q_exchange: accrueInterest()
    q_exchange --> q_calc_tokens: exchangeRate = (underlyingBalance + totalBorrowBalance - reserves) / cTokenSupply
    q_calc_tokens --> q_transfer_in: mintTokens = amountUnderlying / exchangeRate
    q_transfer_in --> q_update: transferFrom(msg.sender, market, amountUnderlying)
    q_update --> q_mint_tokens: cTokenSupply = cTokenSupply + mintTokens
    q_mint_tokens --> [*]: cTokenBalance[msg.sender] = cTokenBalance[msg.sender] + mintTokens
    q_error --> [*]: revert

    note right of q_exchange
        INV-001: exchangeRate >= 1.0 (monotonically increasing due to interest accrual)
        INV-002: cTokenSupply * exchangeRate = underlyingBalance + totalBorrowBalance - reserves
    end note

    note right of q_transfer_in
        INV-003: underlying token transferFrom must succeed before minting cTokens
    end note

     2→title: "redeem (Compound Whitepaper)"
     3→---
     4→stateDiagram-v2
     5→    direction TB
     6→    [*] --> q_validate: msg.sender calls redeem(amount) or redeemUnderlying(amountUnderlying)
     7→    q_validate --> q_accrue: amount > 0 or amountUnderlying > 0
     8→    q_validate --> q_error_zero: amount = 0 and amountUnderlying = 0
     9→    q_accrue --> q_exchange: accrueInterest()
    10→    q_exchange --> q_calc: exchangeRate = (underlyingBalance + totalBorrowBalance - reserves) / cTokenSupply
    11→    q_calc --> q_check_liquidity: redeemAmount = amount * exchangeRate OR redeemTokens = amountUnderlying / exchangeRate
    12→    q_check_liquidity --> q_comptroller: comptroller.redeemAllowed(msg.sender, redeemTokens)
    13→    q_comptroller --> q_check_cash: allowed = true
    14→    q_comptroller --> q_error_collateral: allowed = false (insufficient collateral)
    15→    q_check_cash --> q_transfer_out: market.cash >= redeemAmount
    16→    q_check_cash --> q_error_liquidity: market.cash < redeemAmount
    17→    q_transfer_out --> q_update: transfer(msg.sender, redeemAmount)
    18→    q_update --> [*]: cTokenBalance[msg.sender] = cTokenBalance[msg.sender] - redeemTokens; cTokenSupply = cTokenSupply - redeemTokens
    19→    q_error_zero --> [*]: revert
    20→    q_error_collateral --> [*]: revert insufficient collateral
    21→    q_error_liquidity --> [*]: revert insufficient liquidity
    22→
